text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of what we write. NLP also powers translation tools that change text from one language into another, making communication easier around the world. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where computers decide if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with people online. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology is becoming smarter and more helpful.
